messages:
fiona: heads-up  release blocked: regendiff flagged for generated types in the onboarding sample. looks like pure key-order churn but release-stamp wants a changelog entry.

ci-bot: CI: release/sample-onboard #902 failed  regendiff detected in packages/onboard/src/gen/types.ts

yusuf: paste from regendiff:
```
- export type Team = { id: string; members?: string[]; name?: string }
+ export type Team = { name?: string; members?: string[]; id: string }
```

fiona: this is the ordering-only noise we talked about. it's harmless but blocks the publish flow.

margo: quick unblock: add a one-line changelog "chore(gen): regen (non-functional)" and pin the codegen/typegen versions in the workspace so CI is reproducible. but we need a better policy.

yusuf: agree. quick PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboard-sample/pull/902  pins @redwood/codegen@3.7.2 and adds scripts/normalize-gen.js that stable-sorts keys in generated files. also adds regen-idempotency CI job (runs regen twice).

fiona: nit: please include a short note in the PR describing why this is nondeterministic and reference INF-2244. we want traceability for the release team.

ci-bot: CI started for PR #902.

margo: longer term we should avoid polluting changelogs. proposal: add a "regendiff-ignorelist" for release-stamp that will skip semver/changelog enforcement for diffs matching a safe heuristics set (generated paths + ordering/whitespace/header-only changes). must include automatic compatibility checks (sample-app tests + idempotency) before skipping.

yusuf: additional idea: introduce a canary-codegen channel so we can test new codegen releases against a matrix of repos before they hit all workspaces. that would reduce surprise shuffles.

fiona: product will want transparency: even if we auto-skip changelog entries, publish notes should record that a regen-only change happened and which codegen version produced it. so add an "auto-gen" changelog fragment that release-stamp can append automatically.

margo: CI for PR #902 is green. merging to unblock.

ci-bot: CI finished: all checks passed for PR #902.

release-mgr: re-running release pipeline now. publish step retried. No regendiff found. publish completed: onboard-sample v0.6.7.

yusuf: leaving follow-ups: 1) RFC INF-2244: "semver-guardrails for regen-only diffs" (owners: eng-infra + devex + product), 2) canary-codegen testing plan, 3) audit workspace package.jsons for codegen pins.

fiona: thanks team. closing this thread after RFC opens. :white_check_mark:
